about: Tiny decoder-only transformer trained in Node on the guides' corpus. Every number here is computed by system/school/tinyformer.mjs.

controls.note: each word attends only to itself
each word averages all words so far, ignoring position

probes.note: Copy: the cone goes on the thing Rerun found seven words back.
Copy past a distractor: bell is the nearer thing, but map was found.
Who did it: the answer is the name at the start of the matching sentence.
Which thing: the question repeats the verb, so the object must be looked up.
Long distance: another guide is named in between, and the answer is 19 words back.
Local: after 'lit the' the next word is lamp; the previous word is enough.
